description: Move the start or end edge of one clip to a timeline time. With ripple, later clips on the same track shift to keep their distance; without ripple the edge must not run into a neighbour.

clipId.description: Id of the clip to trim.

toUs.description: Timeline time the edge moves to, in pre-edit coordinates, in microseconds (1 second = 1000000).

ripple.description: Shift later clips on the same track by the length change.
